title: Arc accounts
description: A big left-aligned regular-weight heading over three pastel cards (blue-grey, sage, sand) with 20px corners: an illustration across the top, then a pill badge, a 30px title, a warm-grey paragraph and a bold link pinned to the foot. Stacked on phones. The heading and then each card fade and rise 15px in turn as they scroll into view; a card's contents dim slightly on hover.
notes: card tints come from the theme's accent and secondary colours and its highlight at 30%
the reveal needs CSS scroll-driven animations; elsewhere the cards simply show
illustration slots are faint wash placeholders until you pass media
